scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “The sharp factor-of-IID threshold for the free Ising model on regular trees” (preprints/The-sharp-factor-of-IID-threshold-for-the-free-Ising-model-on-regular-trees-September-26-2026/article.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 236 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 aabb8cc15b9072c5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 1. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every integer d ≥ 3 and every β ≥ 0, the free zero-field Ising law µd,β is a factor of IID in the sense of (1.1) if and only if tanh β ≤ (d − 1)−1/2 . In this range the factor can be chosen to commute with every automorphism on every label input.
